title: SparkMind
tagline: AI tutors for kids built with verifiable data using Zero Gravity
description: We built our AI Tutors on verifiable data, ensuring parents get transparent, reliable assurances about their educational use. To do so, we leveraged Zero Gravity to track and apply data while fine-tuning LLMs for children’s learning. The tutor then functions as an interactive teacher, available through both chat and voice.
how_its_made: Built on Next.js with React and Tailwind, SparkMind hosts six animated, kid-friendly AI tutors whose behavior prompts are fetched from decentralized 0G Storage; Privy handles wallet-or-email log-ins and credit purchases, while Prisma secures encrypted chat transcripts in Postgres, all wrapped in an interactive UI with hover animations, anonymous or authenticated real-time sessions, and automatic cleanup for a smooth, transparent learning experience.
